Name: Classical Garden Statue Obelisks
Author: AirynS
Description:
Designed for use with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/68674623]Wildflour[/url]'s [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16390]Fancy Garden Farm [/url]map, this mod replaces the obelisks with beautiful classical statues! Each statue is designed to be evocative of the location it warps to while still matching together for a cohesive and elegant aesthetic.

For a standalone version of these statues available through Solid Foundations, see Classical Garden Statues!

For even more statues, check out Himetarts & Wildflour's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/17577]H&W's Romantic Furniture[/url]﻿!

[center][b][size=5]Compatibility
[/size][/b][/center]This mod is automatically compatible with custom obelisks added by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7286]Ridgeside Village[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9600]Visit Mount Vapius[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5787]East Scarp[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8587]Downtown Zuzu[/url], and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2571]Deepwoods[/url]! No manual overwriting of files is required.

[b][center][size=5]Installation[/size][/center][/b]To install, simply extract the "[CP] Classical Garden Statues" folder and drop it in your Mods folder.



[center][b][size=5]Configuration[/size][/b]﻿[/center]
Classical Garden Statue Obelisks has two configuration options:

[list]
[*][b]"Seasonal Foliage"[/b] - This option adds seasonal foliage to the base of each statue.
[*][b]"Summer Flowers" [/b]- This option changes the colour of the summer flowers on the statues. It does nothing if "Seasonal Foliage" is set to "false".
[/list]
